🥟 Be a Squishy Dumpling! Get packed, shipped, bought… and UNBOXED by a kid! 📦✨

From factory to toy shelf to a kid's hands: live the whole little life of a squishy!

🎭 PLAY ANY ROLE
👷 Packer • 🚚 Driver • 🛒 Shopper • 🛍️ Cart Pusher • 💰 Cashier • 👩 Parent • 🧒 Kid

🎁 COLLECT
🥟 24 adorable squishies
📦 18 blind box skins

🏠 COZY HOME
Decorate a cozy home for your squishies and take care of your ASMR pet 🐾

🏖️ New Squishy Journeys arrive with every update!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss new squishies, and join our community group!
